O.outcome_detail: professional judgment used to evaluate AI-generated content

cells.quote:
“Cipherbot is helpful, but…” – balanced users demonstrating intentional and ethical engagement, and (3) “A blind date with Cipherbot” – uncritical users heavily reliant on Cipherbot with diminished agency and criticality.

“F-3 participants did not employ professional judgment to evaluate AI-generated content for their assignments (17; −5), nor did they regularly monitor their use of GenAI systems to avoid complete reliance on them (16; −5).”
cells.note: The profile characterization is from the study text; the outcome-specific sentence is quoted from the wiki entry because it does not appear in the supplied study excerpt.

D.comparison: highly fit in any two of the three years (2F)

cells.quote: In the case of performance in language, foreign language, and social science, those who were only fit in year 3 were not significantly different from those who were fit for two years.
cells.note: The study reports no significant difference but does not report an equivalence test or adequate-power basis; therefore this is coded ns, not 0.
